sourceRefs.locator: Aarbøger for Nordisk Oldkyndighed og Historie 1982 (issued 1984), pp. 111–152. Figure 8 and the English results and conclusion on pp. 145–147: four June/July felling estimates for timbers of the inner ditch barrier; D 701 from the outer bridge, August 980 to May 981; what these can date directly.
Section “Trelleborg”, plan and text. Sixteen houses inside the rampart, cemetery with at least 157 men, women and children, and an alternative association with the village 200 metres away.

Advisory-body evaluation, “Brief description” and statement of Outstanding Universal Value. Danish fortresses with broadly shared geometric layout and four gates, attribution during Harald’s reign and interpretive limits on their purpose.

labels.en: Two ditches at one building site

note.de: Hölzer aus der Sperre im inneren Graben und von der Brücke über den äußeren belegen Bauarbeiten 980/81. Der Punkt zeigt die Ringburg bei Slagelse auf Seeland.
note.en: Timbers from the inner ditch barrier and the bridge over the outer ditch place construction in 980–981. The point marks the ring fortress near Slagelse, Zealand.
